external_dependencies.reason: Strict UTF-8, JSON parsing, cryptography, process, and filesystem primitives are provided by the host runtime. The installed Windows PowerShell 5.1 first hop uses .NET Framework before invoking the pinned PowerShell 7 runtime.

external_dependencies.name: Operating-system filesystem identity, locking, and atomic replacement semantics
external_dependencies.reason: Containment, reparse rejection, mutexes, atomic replace, and installation convergence depend on OS semantics.

external_dependencies.name: Operating-system owned process-tree termination and Windows System32 taskkill.exe
external_dependencies.reason: The Windows PowerShell 5.1 launcher lacks Process.Kill(bool); its bounded cleanup invokes the absolute system taskkill executable only for the process it started. Modern hosts use Process.Kill(true). Cleanup is best effort on exceptional OS failure and never establishes successful execution.

external_dependencies.name: PowerShell 7 runtime and parser; Windows PowerShell 5.1 installed first hop
external_dependencies.reason: Selected Runtime work and AST dependency analysis use PowerShell 7. The installed Windows Hook launcher first executes in Windows PowerShell 5.1 with compatible argument quoting and owned process-tree cleanup.
